productArea.name: Home and application navigation
productArea.scope: Use Home widgets and tabs, dismiss announcements, navigate through the desktop sidebar or mobile menu, manage navigation pins, and open the command menu or Configuration cards. Test navigation to destination pages without exploring their features, and leave entity search and settings search to Global search.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Home and inspect its tabs, widgets, announcements, and desktop or mobile navigation. Open the command menu with Ctrl+K or Cmd+K.
Open the Home widgets tab and follow a widget link to inspect its navigation.
Choose Configuration and check its grouped cards and destination links.
